description: This Java class provides services for creating and updating Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRP) events, specifically handling inventory event planning within the manufacturing module of Apache OFBiz. It includes methods to create or update MRP events based on provided parameters, managing quantities and event details.

classes.name: InventoryEventPlannedServices
classes.description: Service class providing methods to create or update manufacturing resource planning (MRP) events related to inventory planning.

methods.name: createMrpEvent
methods.description: Creates or updates an MRP event based on provided context parameters, handling exceptions and returning service status.

methods.name: createOrUpdateMrpEvent
methods.description: Internal method to create a new MRP event or update an existing one by adjusting quantities and event details.
